shortDescription: Manage host (initiator group) on PowerMax/VMAX Storage System

options.name: host_flags
options.description: Input as a yaml dictionary. List of all host_flags- 1. volume_set_addressing. 2. disable_q_reset_on_ua. 3. environ_set. 4. avoid_reset_broadcast. 5. openvms. 6. scsi_3. 7. spc2_protocol_version. 8. scsi_support1. 9. consistent_lun. Possible values are true, false, unset (default state).

options.name: host_name
options.description: The name of the host. No Special Character support except for _. Case sensitive for REST Calls. Creation of an empty host is allowed.

options.name: initiator_state
options.description: Define whether the initiators should be present or absent on the host. absent-in-host - indicates that the initiators should not exist on the host. present-in-host - indicates that the initiators should exist on the host. Required when creating a host with initiators or adding and removing initiators to or from an existing host.

options.name: initiators
options.description: List of Initiator WWN or IQN or alias to be added to or removed from the host.

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new name of the host for the renaming function. No Special Character support except for _. Case sensitive for REST Calls.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax/VMAX array. It is a required parameter for all array-specific operations except for getting a list of arrays in the Gatherfacts module.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the host should exist or not. absent - indicates that the host should not exist in the system. present - indicates that the host should exist in the system.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.
